question: The diagonals of a rhombus are 24 cm and 7 cm. The perimeter of the rhombus is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Diagonals of rhombus bisect each other at right angles

Half diagonals = 12 and 3.5

Side = √(12² + 3.5²) = √(144 + 12.25) = √156.25 = 12.5

Perimeter = 4 × 12.5

**∴ Answer = 50 cm**
